About Philowave

Philowave is a fast-growing hardware tech company specializing in advanced spectrum sensing and adaptive wireless devices. We design physics-based architectures that achieve multi-octave wideband performance and sub-microsecond response times at ultra-low power. We believe in building—not just simulating. Our team works out of dedicated, on-site laboratories equipped with state-of-the-art hardware test and measurement equipment. Join us as we bridge the gap between complex electromagnetic physics and edge-deployed hardware engineering.

About the role

This is an in-person position that is available immediately, both full-time or part-time. If applying part-time, you must be a current student willing to become full-time after graduating. Please do not apply if you cannot satisfy these requirements.

Are you a talented Hardware Engineer passionate about pushing the boundaries of spectrum sensing technology? Join Philowave, a well-funded startup, and contribute to developing advanced, high-performing solutions that outperform the state-of-the-art by orders of magnitude, all while being more cost-effective. Our highly qualified team brings diverse backgrounds and a collaborative spirit.

Responsibilities include

This full-stack hardware design role will have you involved in every stage, from concept to implementation:

  • FPGA development, simulations, and testing 
  • Full-stack hardware design of board-level systems: This includes initial investigations, detailed simulations, schematic capture, and precise PCB layout.
  • Build test platforms: Develop and maintain the necessary infrastructure for rigorous testing.
  • Collaborate: Work closely with our internal team and external partners to achieve project goals.

Qualifications

  • Education & Experience:
  • BSc. or MSc in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Technical Skills:
  • Full-stack development in FPGA platforms
  • Solid knowledge of PCB development.
  • Knowledge in “Edge AI in FPGAs” is highly desirable
  • Proficiency in scripting with Python and MATLAB.

Candidates who don’t meet every qualification are encouraged to apply. We provide hands-on training to help you grow into the position.

Compensation and Benefits

We value our team members and offer a competitive package:

  • Base Salary: $70,000 – $140,000
  • Equity Packages
  • Health Benefits
  • 401k

Location: This is an in-person position based in Champaign, IL.

Keywords: Hardware engineering, FPGA, RF, microwave, millimeter wave
